ratings.comment: LOVED Willie. He'd print the notes for us, and we'd go over them in lecture. Cases always felt relevant to the material, and he made it fun. He offered to meet with me virtually at 8 pm on a Sunday when I was sick, which I thought was very kind. Problem sets really should be started more than the night before.

He is (in my opinion) the greatest professor in the Business School, and it's a real shame he only teaches one class. I wish I could have him as a professor again. He's so chill and causal and the he explains things makes them so easy to understand. He's the kind of professor you dream of having. He's the Business School's hidden gem.
